sources.citation: DSE "DSE4510 MKII & DSE4520 MKII Operator Manual" 057-260 Issue 9 https://electrosynsc.cl/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/DSE4510-MKII-DSE4520-MKII-Operator-Manual-1.pdf (checked: 2026-09-01)

transport: 2-wire maintained dry contact (switch to negative) · open-circuit voltage: 12 V typical · current: 6 mA wetting typical · terminals 14–17 "Configurable Digital Input A–D, Switch to negative", 0.5 mm²; low ≤3.2 V, high ≥8.1 V, survives +60/−24 V (§2.8.1 p.17); configure as "Remote Start On Load" (source 1) or "Off Load" (25)

models.name: DSE4510/4520 MKII
models.notes: 7320 uses the same input family (not read)

gotchas: Contact removed: "Return Delay Timer" then "Cooling Timer" then stop (p.50, §5.3.4 p.88); a re-close during return delay resumes on load.
"If start signals are given, the input is ignored until Auto Mode is entered" (p.85).
Electrical-trip alarms latch and need a reset (p.61).
